channel.name: Family Watch Club
channel.description: Movie companions and old stories for family watch-together nights. Pause-and-talk cards, retold legends, and read-aloud books — our own questions and commentary, never studio content.

hero.title: Family Watch Club
hero.subtitle: Old stories, good questions, and movie nights that turn into conversations.
hero.body_md:
Movies are the myths our kids already know by heart. This channel holds companions that pause a film at the right moment and ask a real question — plus the thousand-year-old legends underneath the movies, retold in our own words.

Two-sided by design: kids get self-contained books and card decks (no accounts, no tracking); grown-ups get the Movie Companion extension and the tools to make their own. Everything here is our own commentary and traditional public-domain stories — no film dialogue, lyrics, or studio artwork, ever.

Start at the harbor: watch.recursive.eco. Copy any companion, change the questions, and offer it back.

grammars._exclude_note: The alice-in-wonderland / winnie-the-pooh / a-painful-playful-process-song folders are marked duplicates of kids-stories-club originals, kept here to exercise the sync loop; exclude them once the loop is verified.
